name: Chestnuts
summary: Hạt dẻ is chestnuts from the grill, eaten alongside the meat and eggs on a cold Sa Pa evening.
howToEat: Buy a handful and peel them at the stall with the other grills.
where: The grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, on cold evenings.
seoTitle: Chestnuts in Sapa — on the cold-night grill
seoDescription: Hạt dẻ grilled with the other town snacks at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market.
